title: Award
description: The decision to give the contract to a supplier. Mirrors the OCDS award block. Suppliers are referenced, never named in free text: a supplier name as a string cannot be joined across contracts, and that is precisely how repeat awards to connected parties stay invisible.

awardId.description: Identifier for this award within the process. Contracts reference it.

title.description: A short label for the award.

description.description: A plain-language summary of what was awarded.

contractPeriodStart.description: When the resulting contract is expected to begin.

contractPeriodEnd.description: When the resulting contract is expected to end.

document.description: Links to supporting documents, e.g. the award notice.
